learning_outcomes.text: As part of the serial production of a mechanical part, the student must be able to carry out a cutting study (choice of tools, proposed machining sequence, etc.).
As part of the serial production of a mechanical part, the student must be able to design and dimension a part-machine interface (PMI).
As part of the serial production of a mechanical part, the student must be able to carry out digital simulation of the machining of the part to be manufactured.
Analyze the geometry and dimensions of an elementary part in order to define the machining operations for manufacturing the part.
Define the orientation of the part in relation to the machine required, and position and hold it in position.
Schedule the machining operations to detail the manufacturing process.
Determine the clamping force in order to size the clamping system.
For each surface to be machined, be able to choose the appropriate cutting tools and their cutting conditions.
Produce a robust digital model of the IPM on a volume modeller.
Check the relevance of the model in relation to the cdc.
Implement Computer Aided Manufacturing software, in line with the proposed process.

syllabus_topics: Study of data in the context of 3-axis CU milling + 4th and 5th positioned axes
Scheduling of operations in the machining phase
Choice of cutting tools based on the definition of the tool/material pairing
Definition of implementation conditions (taking into account technical and economic criteria)
Determine the cycle time for producing a part (excluding access time to the surfaces to be machined)
Model the various components of the workpiece-machine interface
Validation of the process in a digital simulation environment
Critical analysis and suggestions for improvement
teaching_methods: Teacher instruction on fundamentals of workpiece holder design
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
